# NocoBase Studio quality helpers

`studio-quality.yml` runs the checks of the private `nocobase/studio` that need no secret: `Submodule pointer`, `Lint`, `Typecheck`, `Test`, `API document` and `CLI reference` for every request, and `PR description` and `Studio e2e` for pull requests. `nocobase-bot` dispatches it to a repository of the CI repository pool with the same inputs as `2013xile/nocobase-ci`'s `studio-ci.yml` (`request_id`, `event_name`, `head_sha`, `base_sha`, `target_branch`, `pr_number`, `skip_label` and `head_ref`), finds the run by its title `studio-quality:PR-<n>:<request_id>` or `studio-quality:<branch>:<request_id>`, and mirrors each job as a check of the same name on `nocobase/studio`. `Preview` and `Dist`, which need that repository's secrets, stay in its `studio-ci.yml`.

The helpers in this directory are checked out from this repository with a sparse checkout, never from the forwarded source:

- `studio-checkout` validates the dispatch (`validate-inputs.mjs`), asks `nocobase-bot` for a token with the job's OIDC token (`POST /api/ci/studio-source-token`, audience `nocobase-bot`, `{"request_id", "job"}`), checks the fixed commits out with their `vendor/nocobase3` submodule, merges a pull request into its base (`prepare-snapshot.mjs`), and revokes the token before any of Studio's code runs. `submodules: 'false'` skips the framework submodule for a job that reads only Studio's own files and `submodules: shallow` fetches only its committed pointer (the checks and `Studio e2e`; only `Submodule pointer` needs the framework's history), and `pull-request-body: <file>` saves the pull request's `{ "title", "body" }` from `GET /repos/nocobase/studio/pulls/<n>` with the token before it is revoked, failing the job when it cannot be read; `PR description` uses both and then runs Studio's own `scripts/release/check-pr-body.mjs` on that file, checking with the target branch's `scripts/release` (fetched by the checkout, after the token is revoked) when the pull request's base predates that script, so every pull request is checked and an outdated branch is told to merge the latest `dev`. nocobase-bot gives that job's token pull request read access as well. The bot answers only a run of this workflow on `main` that it dispatched, once per job and run attempt, with a token that can only read `nocobase/studio`, so this repository keeps no secret. A job that calls it needs `id-token: write`.
- `studio-framework` builds a pull request against `nocobase/nocobase`'s branch of the same name as its head while that is unmerged (`mirror-workspace.mjs` carries its workspace settings over), and `studio-framework-gate` fails `Submodule pointer` until the committed pointer contains the merged framework change. Both read the public repository with the run's own token.
- `framework-packages.mjs` names, from package.json files only, the framework packages Studio's build needs and the cache key of their `dist` for the chosen framework commit. `Studio e2e` runs it before any of Studio's code and only restores that cache, then builds Studio's own packages and skips the build's dependency step (`NOCOBASE_SKIP_WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCY_BUILD=1`); on a miss it builds as before. `Framework build cache`, which runs after it, checks the names and the key, builds those packages in a checkout of the public `nocobase/nocobase` at that commit with its own lockfile, and is the only job that saves the cache. It never checks Studio out and is not a check on `nocobase/studio`.

`validate-inputs.mjs`, `prepare-snapshot.mjs`, `mirror-workspace.mjs`, `studio-framework` and `studio-framework-gate` are copies of `2013xile/nocobase-ci`'s `.github/nocobase3/`, where `studio-ci.yml` uses them too; change both together. Like every workflow of this repository, a change reaches the pool when `main` is pushed to all of its repositories.

Run the tests with:

```bash
node --test .github/nocobase3/tests/*.test.mjs
```
